# Stage 27 Frontier Ledger

## Proved

- Exact normalized Haar ball and shell volumes on `SU(2)=S^3`.
- Explicit cubic small-ball bounds and negative-log entropy brackets.
- A cancellation-safe evaluator tested at every active package radius.
- A measure-exact two-center hemisphere atlas.

## Consequence

The denominator in a local conditional comparison carries the exact cost

```text
-log v(delta) = 3 log(1/delta) + log(3*pi/2) + O(delta^2).
```

This is the entropy term that competes with the finite-time action gap in
Stage 15. It cannot be erased by quoting only a pointwise action charge.

## Open

No complete nonlinear bad numerator or retained-state-uniform normalizer is
bounded here. The next stage must optimize the action--entropy competition,
not interpret the Haar formula as a probability estimate by itself.
